Suppressed by: Gregory Rasmussen Date: 2026-05-19 Review by: 2027-05-19 Reason: False positive. androidx.sqlite 2.5.1 is the Android Room Kotlin wrapper library. OWASP incorrectly matches its version number "2.5.1" against the native SQLite C library CPE. All CVEs below affect the native C library, not the wrapper.
CVEs: CVE-2015-3414: NULL pointer dereference in sqlite3VdbeExec() in the native SQLite C library before 3.8.9 via a crafted SQL query. CVE-2015-3415: Invalid type validation in WHERE clause processing in the native SQLite C library before 3.8.9, allowing a crash. CVE-2015-3416: Stack-based buffer overflow in sqlite3_value_text() in the native SQLite C library before 3.8.9. CVE-2015-3717: Multiple buffer overflows in the native SQLite C library before 3.8.9 (originally disclosed via Apple iOS advisories). CVE-2015-5895: Multiple unspecified vulnerabilities in the native SQLite C library before 3.8.10.2 (Apple iOS advisory). CVE-2015-6607: NULL pointer dereference in the native SQLite C library before 3.8.9 via a crafted SELECT query. CVE-2016-6153: Insecure temporary file creation in the native SQLite C library through 3.11.0; files created in the current working directory instead of a secure temp location. CVE-2017-10989: Heap-based buffer over-read in getNodeSize() in ext/rtree/rtree.c in the native SQLite C library 3.20.0 and earlier. CVE-2018-20346: Integer overflow in the FTS3 extension in the native SQLite C library before 3.25.3, exploitable via a large FTS query. CVE-2018-20505: Type confusion in the native SQLite C library 3.25.2, causing a crash via a crafted SELECT FROM clause. CVE-2018-20506: Multiple integer overflows in the FTS3 extension in the native SQLite C library before 3.25.3. CVE-2018-8740: NULL pointer dereference in the native SQLite C library through 3.22.0 via a crafted schema with mismatched parentheses in CREATE TABLE. CVE-2019-19645: Infinite recursion in alter.c in the native SQLite C library through 3.30.1, triggered by self-referential views in ALTER TABLE RENAME. CVE-2019-19646: Incorrect handling of NOT NULL in pragma.c in the native SQLite C library through 3.30.1 during integrity_check PRAGMA. CVE-2020-11655: Segmentation fault in the native SQLite C library through 3.31.1 due to incorrect AggInfo initialization in window-function queries. CVE-2020-11656: Use-after-free in the ALTER TABLE implementation in the native SQLite C library through 3.31.1. CVE-2020-13434: Integer overflow in sqlite3_str_vappendf() in printf.c in the native SQLite C library through 3.32.0. CVE-2020-13435: Segmentation fault in the native SQLite C library through 3.32.0 via a crafted query misusing window functions. CVE-2020-13630: Use-after-free in fts3EvalNextRow() in ext/fts3/fts3.c in the native SQLite C library before 3.32.0. CVE-2020-13631: ALTER TABLE can rename a virtual table to match a shadow table name in the native SQLite C library before 3.32.0. CVE-2020-13632: NULL pointer dereference in ext/fts3/fts3_snippet.c in the native SQLite C library before 3.32.0 via crafted matchinfo(). CVE-2020-15358: Heap overflow in select.c query-flattener optimization in the native SQLite C library through 3.32.3. CVE-2022-35737: Array-bounds overflow in the printf functions in the native SQLite C library 1.0.12 through 3.39.x before 3.39.2. CVE-2023-7104: Heap-based buffer overflow in sessionReadRecord() in ext/session/sqlite3session.c in the native SQLite C library through 3.43.0. CVE-2025-6965: Vulnerability in the native SQLite C library (2025 disclosure; refer to NVD for details). CVE-2025-70873: Vulnerability in the native SQLite C library (2025 disclosure; refer to NVD for details). CVE-2026-11822: Vulnerability in the native SQLite C library (2026 disclosure; refer to NVD for details). androidx.sqlite 2.5.1 is the Android Room Kotlin wrapper; the version number falsely matches the native SQLite C library CPE. CVE-2026-11824: Vulnerability in the native SQLite C library (2026 disclosure; refer to NVD for details). Same false CPE match as above.

Suppressed by: Gregory Rasmussen Date: 2026-05-19 Review by: 2027-05-19 Reason: False positive. room-compiler-processing is the Android Room annotation processor library. The word "processing" in the artifact name triggers an incorrect CPE match to the Processing creative-arts framework.
CVEs: CVE-2018-1000840: XML External Entity (XXE) injection in the loadXML() function of the Processing creative-arts coding framework, allowing remote code execution or information disclosure via a crafted XML sketch file. Entirely unrelated to Room.

Suppressed by: Gregory Rasmussen Date: 2026-05-19 Review by: 2027-05-19 Reason: False positive. symbol-processing-api is Google's Kotlin Symbol Processing (KSP) API. The word "processing" in the artifact name triggers an incorrect CPE match to the Processing creative-arts framework.
CVEs: CVE-2018-1000840: XML External Entity (XXE) injection in the loadXML() function of the Processing creative-arts coding framework, allowing remote code execution or information disclosure via a crafted XML sketch file. Entirely unrelated to KSP.

Suppressed by: Gregory Rasmussen Date: 2026-05-19 Review by: 2027-05-19 Reason: False positive. lifecycle-viewmodel is the Android Jetpack ViewModel library; it has no relation to Apache Impala or SkyWalking. The version "2.9.x" incorrectly matches Apache SkyWalking/Impala CPE patterns.
CVEs: CVE-2017-9792: Apache Impala before 2.10.0 improper authorization, allowing unprivileged users to execute Impala queries on restricted data. CVE-2018-11785: Apache Impala before 3.0.0 SASL handshake spoofing, allowing unauthenticated users to authenticate as any registered user. CVE-2018-11792: Apache Impala before 3.0.0 SASL authentication bypass, allowing impersonation of a registered user without credentials. CVE-2019-10084: Apache Impala before 3.3.0 information disclosure, allowing authenticated users to infer restricted database objects via metadata queries. CVE-2021-28131: Apache Impala before 4.0.0 LDAP injection in the impersonation configuration, allowing query execution as another user by an attacker with LDAP write access.

Suppressed by: Gregory Rasmussen Date: 2026-05-19 Review by: 2027-05-19 Reason: CVE-2020-29582 was fixed in Kotlin 1.4.21. The project uses Kotlin 2.2.10, which is fully patched. Older stdlib versions in the Gradle cache are transitive dependencies of the Android Gradle Plugin toolchain, not the app's runtime. Compiler and daemon artifacts are build-only tools never bundled in the APK. CVE-2026-53914 is a false positive: OWASP matches all Kotlin artifacts for this CVE regardless of version; the vulnerability does not apply to the Kotlin standard library or compiler.
CVEs: CVE-2020-29582: JetBrains Kotlin before 1.4.21 creates temporary files in the system temp directory with world-readable permissions, allowing a local attacker to read sensitive compile-time artifacts such as source files or intermediate build products. CVE-2026-53914: Vulnerability attributed to JetBrains Kotlin (2026 disclosure). OWASP CPE matching flags all Kotlin artifacts regardless of version; does not apply to the Kotlin standard library or compiler toolchain used in this project.

Suppressed by: Gregory Rasmussen Date: 2026-05-19 Review by: 2027-05-19 Reason: The gRPC JARs in this project are build-tool dependencies pulled in by the Android Gradle Plugin's Unified Test Platform (UTP). They are not included in the compiled APK or AAR and are never executed at runtime on a user's device.
CVEs: CVE-2023-44487: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack (CVSS 7.5). An attacker sends a continuous stream of RST_STREAM frames to exhaust server resources without completing connections, causing DoS. Affects gRPC before 1.57.3 / 1.58.1. CVE-2024-7246: gRPC certificate verification bypass (CVSS 5.3). A crafted certificate chain can bypass server-side TLS verification in certain configurations, enabling a potential MITM attack. CVE-2026-33186: gRPC authorization bypass (CVSS 9.1, critical). Allows unauthenticated access to gRPC service methods protected by authorization interceptors under certain server configurations (disclosed 2026-03-17).

Suppressed by: Gregory Rasmussen Date: 2026-05-19 Review by: 2027-05-19 Reason: Netty JARs are transitive dependencies of gRPC, which is a build-tool dependency of the Android Gradle Plugin's Unified Test Platform (UTP). They are not included in the compiled APK and are never executed at runtime on a user's device.
CVEs: CVE-2023-34462: SniHandler heap allocation DoS (CVSS 6.5). Before 4.1.94.Final, SniHandler allocates up to 16MB per connection during TLS SNI negotiation before handshake completion, enabling OOM-based DoS. CVE-2023-44487: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Attack (CVSS 7.5). Continuous RST_STREAM frames exhaust server resources without completing connections. Affects Netty before 4.1.100.Final. CVE-2024-29025: HTTP/2 CONTINUATION frame flood (CVSS 5.3). An unbounded sequence of CONTINUATION frames causes unbounded memory consumption in the HTTP/2 decoder. CVE-2024-47535: SslHandler input buffer leak (CVSS 5.5). SslHandler does not release input buffers on decryption exception, leading to native memory exhaustion and OOM-based DoS. CVE-2025-24970: SslHandler native memory corruption (CVSS 7.5). Improper cleanup of native SSL state during channel close can corrupt native memory, potentially crashing the process. CVE-2025-25193: HTTP/1.1 chunked transfer DoS (CVSS 5.3). A crafted chunk size header causes unbounded memory allocation in the HTTP decoder. Suppressed by: Gregory Rasmussen Date: 2026-05-19 Review by: 2027-05-19 Reason: httpclient-4.5.6 is a transitive dependency of the Android Gradle Plugin build toolchain. It is not included in the APK.
CVEs: CVE-2020-13956: URI handling flaw in Apache HttpClient 4.x before 4.5.13 and 5.x before 5.0.3 (CVSS 5.3). Malformed URIs can be resolved differently by the client vs. a proxy, enabling proxy bypass or SSRF in applications that pass untrusted URIs to the client.
